$comment: Generated from files.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to files.yaml>`. Do not edit.

FileAssessment.description: One file of the inventory and the format it is judged to be.

path.description: The file's path in the inventory (file_path).

extension.description: The file name's last extension, lower case and without the dot; empty if none.

format_name.description: The format the file is judged to be, from formats.yaml, or unknown.

media_type.description: The format's media type, from the inventory if it gave one, else from formats.yaml.

open_format.description: Whether formats.yaml records the format as open. False for an unknown format.

pronom_id.description: The PRONOM identifier (PUID) the judgement rests on, or, when judged_by is pronom_unlisted, the first identifier the inventory gave. Absent when the inventory gave none that was used.

FileAssessment.title: FileAssessment

FileCheck.description: A file a person should look at before deposit, and why, judged from names, size and digest in the inventory alone (hints.yaml). A prompt for a person, never a finding about the file's contents, which are never read.

path.description: The file's path in the inventory (file_path).

kind.description: What the name, size or digest suggests.

matched.description: The word of a folder, file or field name, or the file name, that called for the check; absent for an empty file or a duplicate.

question.description: What a person should check, from hints.yaml.

related_paths.description: For a duplicate, the paths of the other files with the same digest.

FileCheck.title: FileCheck

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

description: The payload of advisor.files: each file of the inventory with the format it is judged to be, and whether that format is open. It judges from the inventory alone and reads no file.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

checks.description: The files a person should look at, in the inventory's order and, for each file, in the order of hints.yaml. Empty when no name, size or digest called for one, which says nothing about what the files hold.

limitations.description: What this agent does not yet do.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: FormatAssessment
